$comment: Patterns of the repeated-values check (GEN-18, scripts/pipeline/lib/analysis/repeats.mjs) for C#. `defaults` read a configuration source (options classes; appsettings*.json are read as JSON); `constants` read every C# file; `fallbacks` are matched on changed lines; a configuration read (`config["Shop:Timeout"]`, `GetValue<T>("Shop:Timeout")`) is matched by its qualified key. {literal} is a number or a quoted string. Named groups: key/value, name/value, expr/value. `comments` matches a whole-line comment, whose literals are prose and are not checked. `rootReceiver` names the root configuration a quoted read starts from (its key is the whole path), and `rootDeclared` finds a receiver declared as it ({name} is the receiver); `sectionAssign` finds a variable given a section ({name} is the variable), whose reads are under that section; a read on any other receiver is a section the scanner cannot resolve.
